name: Media converter symbol
summary: Network symbol for a media converter linking copper Ethernet to optical fibre, drawn as a box with electrical and optical ports.
description: A media converter changes the physical medium of an Ethernet link from copper twisted pair to optical fibre, without routing or switching. Diagrams draw a box with a copper port on one side and a fibre port, often marked with a light arrow, on the other.

On electrical and control drawings, media converters appear where a device with copper Ethernet must reach a remote location or cross an area with earth potential differences. Their power supply and mounting in the panel are shown on the schematic. The symbol does not show the fibre type or wavelength. The fibre port must match the cable.
distinction: A network switch forwards traffic between many ports; a media converter only changes the medium on one link.
